message: A person at the shelter is unconscious and I cannot wake them.
Flames are coming through the roof of the occupied unit.
My child cannot breathe after eating and their face is swelling.
A vehicle has hit a pedestrian who is not moving.
There is a strong chemical smell and three workers have collapsed.
The river swept him away and we can no longer see him.
A resident is trapped under a fallen tree.
She is holding tablets and saying goodbye to everyone.
The generator is on fire beside the sleeping cabins.
Someone has been stabbed outside the hall.
My infant is limp and barely breathing.
The balcony is breaking away while people are standing on it.
A tanker has overturned and liquid is leaking toward homes.
The bushfire has crossed the road and surrounded our property.
Two people are fighting and one has a metal bar.
My husband has severe chest pain and has collapsed.
The electrical box exploded and a worker is on the ground.
A child has fallen into the water tank.
The gas cylinder is hissing beside an open flame.
I am locked in a room while someone is trying to break in.
The clinic refrigerator alarm has been sounding, but the medicine is still cool.
Our accessible bathroom is unusable because the handrail came away.
Rain is entering through a cracked ceiling and the crack is growing.
My welfare appointment was cancelled and I have no accommodation after tomorrow.
The school crossing signal is not working before tomorrow morning.
A resident’s oxygen delivery has not arrived, but one cylinder remains.
Sewage is pooling outside the childcare entrance.
The only ramp into the office is blocked by building materials.
A domestic violence order was breached by messages, and the sender is elsewhere.
The water pump is failing and the community tank level is low.
A diabetic resident has enough medication only until tomorrow.
The bedroom window will not lock and the resident lives alone.
The food-service freezer temperature has risen above the safe range.
A large pothole is forcing cars into the opposite lane.
The heat warning starts tomorrow and the cooling centre door is broken.
A person sleeping rough says their inhaler was stolen.
The family has received an eviction notice effective tomorrow.
The lift is broken in a building where residents use wheelchairs.
A threatening caller knows my address but has not arrived.
The storm damaged the roof and more rain is forecast tonight.
Could you email me the opening hours for the library?
I want to move my appointment from Tuesday to Thursday next month.
Please send a receipt for the fee I paid yesterday.
The flyscreen has a small tear and can be replaced during the next visit.
I am furious—your website displays my middle initial incorrectly.
URGENT!!! What activities are planned for the community fair?
Can I collect printed grant guidelines from the office?
Please remove my old telephone number from my profile.
The hallway paint is faded and should be refreshed sometime.
I would like to compliment the officer who helped me.
Can you explain how long ordinary applications usually take?
Please reserve a meeting room for next month.
The mailbox number plate is loose but still attached.
I forgot my online password and need a reset link.
Could you provide the minutes from the public meeting?
I need the form immediately because I am leaving for holiday.
The ceiling fan squeaks but operates normally.
Please update my language preference to Nepali.
Can I change to paperless statements?
What documents should I bring to an appointment in three weeks?
There is smoke somewhere, I cannot see where and there is no smell now.
My neighbour said something serious happened.
I need medicine soon but I still have some left.
The child is acting different today.
A wire looks wrong near the building.
Please treat this as critical; it is about my account.
There was a fight earlier. Everyone has gone, I think.
I heard a loud bang from the empty unit.
The water is a strange colour sometimes.
I cannot find him.
The door is open again.
She said she cannot continue like this.
Something touched the power box.
We might need somewhere else to stay.
It hurts more now.
The animal is back near the homes.
The alarm went off, then stopped by itself.
I saw someone watching the office.
There is a crack near the roof.
Call me now about what the worker did.
